title: Sr. Engineer / AM
description:
**Position Summary**
 Magellan Aerospace (Tumkur) Private Limited has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Engineer / AM. This position is responsible for the end\-to\-end execution of aerospace manufacturing projects, from receipt of raw material through delivery to the customer.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Responsible for the complete project execution cycle, from receipt of raw material through delivery to the customer.
* Act as the single point of contact for customers regarding FAI \& production activities.
* Represent project updates during customer weekly/monthly calls.
* Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
* Track project progress and manage changes to project scope, schedule, and cost.
* Facilitate effective communication among stakeholders, team members, and management.
* Identify potential project risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Lead and motivate the project team, resolve conflicts, and ensure effective collaboration.
* Handle system\-related activities, including AS9100, OHSAS/MOS, etc.
* Should have awareness and understanding of ISO 14001:2015 requirements.


**Position Requirements**
 Ideally, the jobholder should possess the following Education Qualifications, Skills and experience.
   

  

**Education Qualification:** 
 BE/B.Tech in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or above preferred
   

  

**Indicative Years of Experience Required:**
 Minimum 5\+ years of experience in the aerospace engineering/manufacturing domain.
   

  

**Skills Set Required:**
* The applicant should have knowledge \& experience of various metal cutting processes like – Turning, Milling, Drilling, boring, slitting etc.
* Hands on experience in NX CAD CAM, Feature CAM,CATIA CAM V5 / Auto CAD, Vericut software, NX and Feature CAM is must.
* Should have knowledge of various cutting tools \& holders required for above operation. Knowledge of cutting parameters needed for Aluminum alloy’s, Titanium, Inconel is must.
* Hands on experience in SIEMENS 810D, 840D, FANUC \& Mazak control.
* 2D (Manual) \& 3D CNC programming knowledge.
* Fluent knowledge of GD\&T, fits and tolerances, aerospace materials, special processes \& treatments
* Awareness of PFMEA, 5S, 7problem solving QC tools etc.

title: Technical Program Manager - Hardware Engineering
description:
**Technical Program Manager – Hardware Engineering** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of electronic hardware programs from concept, design, validation, and NPI through volume manufacturing.
* Serve as the primary customer interface, ensuring alignment on technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, and business objectives.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans covering scope, schedule, budget, quality, and resource commitments.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across hardware engineering, NPI, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and sourcing teams.
* Identify, track, and mitigate technical, operational, supply chain, cost, and schedule risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Lead engineering change management (ECO/ECR), assessing impacts to cost, schedule, product performance, and production readiness.
* Ensure product validation, compliance, reliability, and qualification activities are completed in line with customer and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee design transfer, manufacturability reviews, production readiness assessments, and successful ramp\-up into mass production.
* Monitor program KPIs including yield, quality, cost, schedule adherence, customer satisfaction, and on\-time delivery performance.
* Prepare executive reviews, customer communications, program status reports, and management decision packages.



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong background in electronics hardware development, product engineering, NPI, and manufacturing operations.
* Deep understanding of EMS environments including PCBA, system integration, testing, assembly, quality control, and manufacturing processes.
* Expertise in DFM, product validation, reliability testing, engineering change control, and production qualification.
* Strong knowledge of BOM management, product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems, and configuration management.
* Proficiency in project and program management tools such as Microsoft Project and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong understanding of risk management, schedule development, budget control, and program governance methodologies.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level** 



* 15\+ years of experience in Hardware Engineering, Technical Program Management, Product Development, NPI, or EMS manufacturing environments.
* Proven track record of delivering complex electronic hardware products from design through mass production.
* Experience managing global customer programs and leading cross\-functional teams across engineering and manufacturing organizations.
* Demonstrated success in customer\-facing program leadership, stakeholder management, and executive\-level communication.
* Strong experience coordinating distributed engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing teams across multiple locations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent programs while balancing technical, commercial, quality, and schedule objectives.

title: Technical Program Manager - Bid Management
description:
**About the Business:**




  





 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
 



  





**Responsibilities:**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical bid governance from RFQ receipt through management approval and final submission readiness.
* Own technical solution architecture and ensure alignment across NPI, process engineering, manufacturing, test, automation, quality, supply chain, and operations functions.
* Develop compelling technical narratives, win themes, solution strategies, and executive\-level presentations to support customer proposals and management reviews.
* Lead go/no\-go decisions, pricing reviews, approval gates, and management decision forums, ensuring risks, assumptions, and deviations are clearly communicated.
* Manage bid priorities, resource allocation, and execution across multiple concurrent opportunities while maintaining quality and schedule commitments.
* Review RFQs, customer specifications, drawings, BOMs, technical data packages, and standards to identify gaps, risks, and clarification requirements.
* Develop structured customer clarification logs and convert incomplete requirements into documented assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and closure actions.



  





**Essential Attributes:**



* RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability management.
* Bid strategy development, solution storytelling, executive communication, and customer\-facing proposal presentations.
* Proposal governance, gated review processes, Red Team and Gold Team reviews, and approval gate management.
* Technical solution architecture and cross\-functional integration across NPI, manufacturing process, test engineering, automation, quality, and supply chain domains.
* Integrated planning, RAID management, risk mitigation, change management, and configuration control.
* Commercial understanding of cost models, schedules, capital investments, risks, contractual obligations, and business case development.
* Development of resource loading models, cycle\-time calculations, capacity planning, equipment sizing, tooling requirements, implementation schedules, and cost estimates.
* Supplier evaluation, quotation analysis, make\-versus\-buy assessments, and technical recommendation development.



  





**Qualifications:**



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* PMP certification and/or MBA preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level:**



* 10\-15 years of experience in bid management, technical program management, NPI, manufacturing industrialization, engineering, or related functions within EMS or complex product manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience supporting customer RFQs, technical proposals, manufacturing industrialization programs, and cross\-functional solution development.
* Proven track record of leading multidisciplinary teams and providing evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
* Ability to work effectively with global customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
* Willingness to travel for customer workshops, supplier reviews, equipment trials, and program reviews as required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer\-facing presentation capabilities.

title: Process Lead - Assembly
description:
**Responsibilities** 



* Own box\-build and final assembly process architecture, including station sequencing, line balancing, semi\-automation concepts, and poka\-yoke implementation.
* Review RFQs, drawings, BOMs, specifications, and customer requirements to develop compliant and executable assembly solutions.
* Develop manufacturing estimates covering cycle times, manpower loading, equipment, tooling, fixtures, NRE, capex, and implementation timelines.
* Define assembly process assumptions, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and mitigation plans to support bid submissions.
* Establish torque control, press\-fit processes, assembly validation requirements, and critical process acceptance criteria.
* Design ESD\-compliant assembly areas and manufacturing workflows aligned with ANSI/ESD S20\.20 requirements.
* Evaluate equipment, tooling, and fixture solutions, including supplier assessments and make\-versus\-buy recommendations.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across engineering, quality, operations, automation, supply chain, and finance to ensure execution readiness.
* Prepare technical calculations, process capacity analyses, and supporting evidence for proposal reviews and management approvals.
* Define process validation, handover deliverables, and manufacturing readiness requirements for NPI and production launch.



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Mechatronics, Industrial, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate specialization in Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Strong knowledge of box\-build and final assembly manufacturing processes, line balancing, workstation design, and assembly industrialization.
* Expertise in DFM, PFMEA, Control Plans, process capability analysis, and manufacturing quality planning.
* Proficiency in process simulation or line\-balancing tools, advanced Excel modelling, and assembly equipment programming tools.
* Working knowledge of ESD requirements, ergonomics, operator safety, yield improvement, OEE, and productivity optimization.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, and MES systems supporting BOM management, routing, work instructions, and traceability.



  





**Desired Experience Level** 



* 8\-12 years of experience in Assembly Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, NPI, Manufacturing Industrialization, or EMS operations.
* Proven experience supporting customer RFQs, technical proposals, manufacturing process development, and production ramp\-up activities.
* Demonstrated capability in assembly line design, cycle\-time validation, capacity modelling, manpower planning, and automation assessments.
* Experience defining torque management, press\-fit controls, fixture strategies, and assembly process validation methodologies.
* Strong capability to convert incomplete customer requirements into executable manufacturing solutions with clear assumptions and risk mitigation plans.
* Experience working with global customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams, supported by strong stakeholder management and customer\-facing communication skills.

title: Electrical Design and Validation Lead
description:
**About the Business:** 




  





**Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL)** 
 is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management ICs, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCUs), and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand across automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications, and artificial intelligence markets.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group, which operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission to improve the quality of life of the communities it serves globally through long\-term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with trust.
 



*Space* 




**Responsibilities:** 




  





**RFQ Review \& Technical Assessment** 



* Review RFQs, drawings, specifications, BOMs, data packages, and customer standards to identify gaps and develop structured clarification lists.
* Assess technical feasibility, electrical design requirements, product risks, and compliance considerations for proposed solutions.



**Electrical Design \& Technology Leadership** 



* Lead the electrical and product technology workstream within the bid team.
* Direct DFM, Electrical Engineering (EE) design, and RF engineering activities to ensure robust and manufacturable product solutions.
* Own risk arbitration across schematic, PCB layout, component selection, and radio frequency domains.



**Solution Development \& Risk Management** 



* Define technical solutions, basis of estimate, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Drive risk assessments and validation planning to support evidence\-based decision making and proposal development.

* Develop estimates for resource loading, tooling requirements, NRE costs, CapEx investments, lead times, and implementation milestones.
* Prepare auditable calculations, compliance matrices, technical narratives, costing inputs, and management approval documentation.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer teams to ensure alignment on technical solutions.
* Challenge unsupported assumptions and reconcile inconsistencies across engineering, process, test, automation, quality, and supply chain inputs.



**Supplier \& Customer Engagement** 



* Support supplier technical evaluations, quotation reviews, and make\-versus\-buy analyses.
* Participate in customer clarification meetings, solution reviews, Red Team reviews, and Gold Team reviews to ensure proposal readiness and closure of assigned actions.

* Define electrical validation strategies, acceptance criteria, qualification requirements, and key deliverables needed for transfer into NPI and volume manufacturing.

1. Strong expertise in electrical design assurance, DFM/DFx methodologies, and design review leadership.
2. Experience in electrical system design, PCB design reviews, schematic validation, RF design considerations, and product engineering.
3. Proven ability to lead cross\-functional engineering teams supporting complex customer RFQs, technical proposals, and industrialization programs.
4. Strong understanding of technical risk assessment, validation planning, and evidence\-based engineering decision\-making.
5. Experience in product lifecycle management, engineering change control, configuration management, and release governance.
6. Ability to evaluate manufacturability, reliability, and product readiness throughout the product lifecycle.
7. Proven experience supporting NPI, manufacturing industrialization, and volume production transfer within EMS or complex manufacturing environments.
8. Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
9. Ability to collaborate effectively with global customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
10. Willingness to travel for customer workshops, supplier reviews, equipment trials, and program reviews as required.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, or another discipline relevant to the role.
* Postgraduate specialization in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Design, RF Engineering, Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level:** 



* **12\-18 years of experience** 
 in Electrical Design, Product Engineering, Design Validation, RF Engineering, NPI, Manufacturing Industrialization, or related engineering functions within EMS, Electronics Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Telecommunications, Automotive, or other complex product manufacturing environments.
